name: add
title: N-bit adder with carry in and carry out (warm-up)

banlist._comment: Run-time addition is the task. Yosys's alumacc merges + and - chains into the same $alu/$macc cells as *, so all of + - * / % ** are banned on run-time operands. Constant arithmetic (N-1, i+1 over a genvar, $clog2(N)) stays allowed.

postsynth._comment: The checker's postsynth stage (README.md, `postsynth` in the task.json table): the fixed corners (134 vectors at N = 16), the harvested comparison constants and 4000 seeded random vectors; ls-sv about 0.3 ms per vector for the ripple reference.

references.note: proved with the sv_comb tactics (sv_structure, sv_equations) and LeanModels.Sv.CombLib: the intended workflow, see PROVING.md

the same ripple adder with the carry cell as an always_comb if/else inside the generate loop (WP-G): proved with the same tactics through the lowering (sv_structure returns noSelfRead_k; the bridge satisfiedAt_of_lowered is local to the file)

the same ripple adder with the WHOLE bit cell, carry and sum, in ONE always_comb body that writes two windows (WP-G S1b gate d): the proof is add_proc.lean's, character for character (tests/add/same_proof.py pins that), because sv_equations names a fact by its signal and the ordinal of the window that writes it

the same ripple adder written with ~ and the conditional expression ?: (WP-G S2: e[i] = ~(a[i] ^ b[i]); c[i+1] = e[i] ? a[i] : c[i]; s[i] = ~(e[i] ^ c[i])): proved with the same tactics, the carry cell's ?: reads as an if on e[i] (the same score as add_n: Yosys normalizes both to one netlist)
the same design (byte-identical to the first), proved with no tactic: the measured baseline of the proof effort
